### Swift alpha

Handled errors. No fatal-crash or native replay.

Browser replay is for web apps. Node.js and Python capture server error context. Swift is a handled-error alpha, with no fatal-crash or native-replay support. What a report holds depends on capture settings and the event. Replay is reconstructed page activity, not a video. Replay can be unavailable. Request and response bodies are not captured. A stack is evidence, not a confirmed cause. Inputs are masked by default. Visible page text can still be recorded; strict mode masks page text too.
